name: Little Devil
storyline:
Hell was supposed to be a place of order. Dark, yes. Terrifying, absolutely. But organised. Efficient. A well oiled machine of eternal damnation.

It is none of those things.

The Seven Deadly Sins have abandoned their posts, Lucifer has checked out entirely, and the whole underworld has descended into an embarrassing, chaotic shambles. And through it all, Little Devil cannot catch a single moment of rest. Every failure, every mess, every catastrophic lapse in hellish management lands squarely on his shoulders whether he likes it or not.

He has decided he does not like it.

No more waiting. No more hoping someone else will fix it. If he is never going to get any peace anyway, he might as well be the one calling the shots. Little Devil is taking over. He will fight through the ranks, topple the Sins one by one, and dethrone the most useless ruler in the history of the underworld.

Hell is about to get a new boss. One who just really, really wanted a nap.
summary:
Little Devil is a top-down roguelike horror-comedy dripping with 90s retro attitude, grotesque demons, and chaotic dungeon energy — developed by Michael Armstrong-Ingram of MI Pixel Ltd.

Descend into Hell armed with bizarre powers that shoot from your hands. Battle grotesque demons, navigate procedurally generated dungeons filled with ever-shifting room layouts, survive encounters with massive bosses, and die. Then do it all again. Permadeath means every run is a fresh fight for survival but the chaos never gets old.
Face off against the Seven Deadly Sins as bosses, each with their own grotesque attack patterns and behaviours. Loot, upgrade, discover secret rooms, and uncover trial challenges that reward the bold with hidden treasures.

The world of Little Devil runs deeper than the game alone. The Little Devil Webcomic, updating weekly on WEBTOON and free to read, tells the origin story of the characters and world you'll be battling through.
